section.text: *NOTE: Pursuant to section 7085 of D.C. Law 25-50, this section applies only with respect to public restrooms managed or maintained by the District of Columbia Public Library as of October 1, 2023.*
section.heading: Definitions.

annotations.annotation: Section 7085 of D.C. Law 25-50 modified section 4 of D.C. Law 24-250 removing the applicability provision impacting this section. Therefore the creation of this section by section 2 of Law 24-250 has been implemented only with respect to public restrooms managed or maintained by the District of Columbia Public Library.
